visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short grey hair, wearing a dark grey padded winter jacket, walks away from the camera through a white-walled hallway towards a brown wooden door. The lighting is bright and indoor-natural, illuminating the polished floor tiles which reflect the surrounding environment and the man's shadow. (2) An elderly couple stands side-by-side on a patch of artificial green grass in a tranquil outdoor park. The woman wears a bright red winter coat and glasses, while the man wears a grey jacket over a patterned sweater with sunglasses. Behind them is a small pond with swimming ducks and bare autumn trees under an overcast sky. (3) In a brightly lit indoor room, a young man in a cream-colored sweater and two older men are crouched on the floor. They are actively engaged in assembling large, light-colored wooden panels to construct a wardrobe, using their hands to align the boards. (4) A young man stands on a tall wooden A-frame ladder against a beige wall, while an older woman below interacts with him, holding a small tool up toward him. The room is filled with bright daylight coming from a large window with a sunburst-style decorative frame. (5) The young man, now wearing a black shirt, walks into a tidy, fully furnished bedroom featuring the newly assembled wooden furniture, a white bed, and multiple storage cabinets. He explores the space with a satisfied expression. (6) Close-up shots of physical photographs showing the young man as a child with his family members in various settings, highlighting a nostalgic passage of time. (7) The young man is seen packing black clothing into a large cardboard box on the floor of the bedroom, with furniture and a ring light tripod visible in the background. (8) He stands in the center of the finished room with his arms outstretched, smiling at the camera to showcase the completed renovation. (9) The young man, the older woman, and the older man stand in a circle holding hands together, raising them in a celebratory gesture. (10) A LEGO figure stands on the wooden table in the foreground, while the background fades into a blurred photograph of the young man as a baby with his parents.
